description: Capability for the compact popup window (development-plan.md section 25). Core only: the popup reads and writes tasks and launches routines through this app's own commands, which are not permission-gated, and needs `core:event` so it can hear `popup://shown` and the cross-window data-changed broadcast. Deliberately narrower than the main window's capability — no filesystem, no dialog, no notification plugin from a window whose whole job is a checklist.
